title: Weakly etale morphism of schemes
statement: Let $f:U\to Y$ be a morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme]. It is *weakly etale* if $f$ is flat [def-weil-scheme-morphism-properties] and its diagonal $\Delta_f:U\to U\times_YU$ is flat.

source.place: Bhatt-Scholze, The pro-etale topology for schemes, Definition 4.1.1, p. 27; also literature/stacks-project/more-morphisms.tex, Definition more-morphisms-definition-weakly-etale (Tag 094P)
